title: Wrap auth register handler in DB transaction to prevent orphaned users and TOCTOU
description: The POST /api/auth/register handler performs multi-step DB operations without a transaction. Two issues: (1) user row is inserted before invite token is validated — if invite is invalid, a user exists with no workspace membership; (2) the WORKSPACE_MODE=single first-user check and INSERT have a TOCTOU window where two concurrent registrations could both bypass the gate. Fix: wrap the entire register handler body in a BEGIN...COMMIT transaction block. This makes the whole registration atomic.
